response.sql:
SELECT AVG(media_type_avg_bytes_per_ms)
FROM (
  SELECT mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
) AS per_media_type;

assumptions.assumption: Each qualifying track contributes equally to its media type’s average, and each media type with at least one qualifying track contributes equally to the final simple average.
